description.value: Pizzalicious Donair Shop is a pizza and donair restaurant on Cleveland Avenue in Squamish, serving a broad menu of classic and specialty pizzas, beef and lamb or chicken donairs, salads, wings, and sides. The kitchen is halal, and the menu spans vegetarian-friendly options including falafel, veggie pizzas, and samosas alongside meat-heavy platters. It has built a loyal local following and offers online ordering with pickup available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, operating business at 38163 Cleveland Ave, Squamish with phone +1 604-390-0090; reviews as recent as May 2026 corroborate current operation. Takeout/pickup is explicitly offered via 'Pickup 15 min' and an online ordering system. Vegetarian options are confirmed through multiple menu items (Veggie Munch Pizza, Falafel Donair, Veggie Samosa, Pesto Veggie Pizza, Garden Salad); OSM's diet:halal=yes is consistent with the donair and halal-style menu. No evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pizzalicious' but the website and all branding consistently use 'Pizzalicious Donair Shop'; listing updated to website name.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed fields for phone and address are null.
OSM outdoor_seating=no confirmed; indoor_seating=yes from OSM not contradicted by website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant in Squamish with recent reviews and a functioning online ordering system. A useful refuelling stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian items: Veggie Munch Pizza, Pesto Veggie Pizza, Indian Style Veggie Pizza, Falafel Donair, Falafel Rice with Salad, Veggie Samosa, Garden Salad. Vegan and GF options not confirmed
